description: Use when tracking crops, greenery or land change month by month. Input: lat, lon, radius_m (200-10000), months (1-12), optional end date. Output: JSON series per month: clearest scene, area cloud %, NDVI mean/median, status (ok, cloudy, no_scene), plus min/max and first-to-last change. Numbers only, no images. No scene at all: 404, not charged. Example: ?lat=36.35&lon=127.38&months=6 Price: $0.012 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

months.description: Number of calendar months ending with the end month (default 6)

radius_m.description: Half-width of the square area in meters (default 2000)

name: satellite_trend
title: Vegetation trend from space: monthly Sentinel-2 NDVI and cloud % for any place (1-12 months)
